title: User temporary files
description: Temporary files of apps in the system $TMPDIR folder. Apps remove them on their own, but they are often left behind after crashes. By default only files older than 7 days are shown, because newer ones may be in use.

title: Crash reports
description: Reports of app crashes and hangs collected by macOS.

title: Downloaded iOS updates
description: iPhone and iPad software update files downloaded when updating through the Mac.

title: iPhone and iPad backups
description: Local backups of iOS devices. If the iCloud backup is up to date, the local one may be unnecessary. Requires Full Disk Access.
regeneration: An old backup cannot be recreated; you can make a new one by connecting the device.

title: Attachments opened in Mail
description: Copies of attachments opened in Mail. The originals stay in the messages.

title: App logs
description: Log files written by apps to ~/Library/Logs. They are useful only for diagnosing problems.

title: Other app caches
description: Remaining folders in ~/Library/Caches. By macOS convention, this is data that apps can recreate; quit an app before removing its cache.
regeneration: The app recreates its cache on launch.

title: Trash
description: Files moved to the Trash, including by GRUZ. Space is freed only after you empty the Trash in Finder. Requires Full Disk Access to measure the size.
